Event segmentation analysis operations
Get metrics for an event with segmentation. Returns event totals, unique users, or other metrics broken down by time intervals and optional segment or group-by properties.

query.description: (Required) A JSON-encoded event object with at minimum an event_type field. For funnel analysis, multiple e parameters define each funnel step.
(Required) The start date in YYYYMMDD format.
(Required) The end date in YYYYMMDD format.
The metric to compute. Options include uniques, totals, pct_dau, average, histogram, sums, value_avg, or formula.
Time interval granularity. Use -300000 for real-time, 1 for daily, 7 for weekly, or 30 for monthly.
Segment definitions as a JSON-encoded array of segment objects for filtering results.
The property to group results by, such as a user property or event property name.
The number of group-by values to return. Default is 100, max is 1000.

The Amplitude Dashboard REST API provides programmatic access to the same data displayed in Amplitude's dashboard charts and graphs. It returns results in JSON format and supports queries filtered by event types, user segments, cohorts, and date ranges. Developers can use this API to build custom reporting tools, export chart data, or integrate Amplitude analytics into external dashboards and business intelligence systems.
